mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 59 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park with clear skies, though please be aware of the elevated air quality.

The Verona Plan Commission has an agenda for November 4th including a final plat for 80 lots at Ardent Glen and site plans for the 1979 Milky Way development. Also, property tax bills will arrive by December 15th.
It is a busy time in Verona with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15th, they arrested a school bus driver for operating a vehicle while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The Culver's of Verona is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
